findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: larp_check, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches · Private data: check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches, launch_record, check_agent, check_hook, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_tokens, fundamentals, insider_trades, institutions, guidance, macro, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches · Public sink: larp_check, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, fundamentals, guidance · Destructive: unwatch_coin.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: larp_check, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches · Private data: check_coin, dev_record, wallet_privacy, fresh_launches, launch_record, check_agent, check_hook, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, stock_tokens, fundamentals, insider_trades, institutions, guidance, macro, stock_events, watch_coin, my_watches · Public sink: larp_check, check_tx, presign_risk_report, stock_token, fundamentals, guidance · Destructive: unwatch_coin

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
